description: This file defines helper functions related to configuration and MAC address extraction for a specific hardware device (Phicomm K2T). It includes functions to load configuration from MTD partitions and retrieve MAC addresses using JSON parsing.

methods.name: k2t_config_load
methods.description: Loads configuration data from a specific MTD partition named 'config' and verifies its size.

methods.name: k2t_get_mac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address or a specified variable from the device configuration JSON.
